Live from dashboard_db.mv_btd_funnel_stagewise — same source verified against Superset's own "Book to Delivery Funnel" dashboard. Proposal Failed, Proposal Retry Failed and Proposal Retry are exact — every proposal_id in the bucket, cross-checked against Kibana (click a cell, or use "Download logs" below for all three buckets at once). KYC and Inspection Pending/Failed cells are clickable for a real Kibana error sample (shared between the pending/failed pair — Kibana's stage field can't split them further). Other stage cells (Proposal Pending/TAT Expired, Issuance, PDF, User Cancelled, etc.) are plain counts — no validated per-proposal or per-stage mapping exists for them. "Today" is a partial day in progress.
Pick an insurer, vehicle type and day — the full Booked → Issued breakdown renders as a stage list below. Rows with a ▸ arrow are clickable: they expand in place to show every real proposal_id/error/request/response Kibana has for that exact insurer/vehicle/day/stage (same underlying data as the B2D Funnel tab's cell click-through, just one insurer/day at a time). KYC and Inspection Pending/Failed share one log set (Kibana's stage field can't split them further) — same caveat as the matrix view.
Booked→Delivered % over time, across all insurers, split Inspection-required vs Non-inspection-required (is_inspection_required, a real per-proposal flag — not a vehicle_type guess). The last ~15 days can still move as inspection TAT resolves — this data is fully re-pulled from source on every dashboard refresh, so a day's numbers here are always current as of "Data till" above, not frozen at first-seen. Overall/Total B2D% is the weighted combination of Inspection + Non-inspection for that period.

Day-on-day error-type breakdown for not-issued B2D proposals (KYC/Inspection/Proposal-stage failures), from Kibana ERROR_EVENTs. Limited to Kibana's own ~10-day retention — much shorter than the B2D Trends tab's 90-day window, since this tab needs the raw error log (not just the DB's coarse status), and Kibana simply doesn't keep logs that long. "% Share" = that error type's share of total failures logged that day for the selected insurer/vehicle (same definition as the QSR Errors tab's % Share toggle). The benign internal "state transition is not defined" noise is already excluded.

Select a specific insurer and vehicle type above to view the day-on-day error breakdown.
